# Contributing to Watchdog

Open an issue to discuss a change, or open a pull request directly for a small fix. Read [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) for commands and conventions, [`docs/contributing/ci-gates.md`](../docs/contributing/ci-gates.md) for what CI and the hooks run, and [`docs/contributing/testing/index.md`](../docs/contributing/testing/index.md) for how tests are written and run. Run `pnpm check`, `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` before you push.

## Contributor License Agreement

Before your first pull request is merged, comment on it exactly: `I have read the CLA in CLA.md and agree to it`. The agreement is [`CLA.md`](../CLA.md). It is a license grant, not a copyright assignment: you keep your copyright. It lets the project offer a commercial license alongside AGPL-3.0 (see the README), which is why it is required. One comment covers your later pull requests.

If you contribute on behalf of an employer, your employer signs [`CLA-corporate.md`](../CLA-corporate.md) instead: contact the owner, [@kzndotsh](https://github.com/kzndotsh) on GitHub, the same contact the README gives for commercial licensing. The maintainer checks for the agreement before merging.
